d: Jet black hair with a straight-cut fringe and long, flowing strands. Large, shimmering purple eyes with a gentle expression. An adolescent appearance with a slender build. Wearing a white and purple outfit consisting of a ruffled off-the-shoulder top, a black belt with a silver buckle, and a large purple translucent bow at the waist. A silver, double-looped halo floats above the head and a small black headset microphone is attached to the side of the face.
